item.raw_source:
import Mathlib

open Metric Filter Topology Set Nat

noncomputable abbrev putnam_2008_b3_solution : ℝ := (Real.sqrt 2 / 2)
-- Real.sqrt 2 / 2
/--
What is the largest possible radius of a circle contained in a $4$-dimensional hypercube of side length $1$?
-/
theorem putnam_2008_b3
    (H : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4)))
    (H_def : H = {P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4) | ∀ i : Fin 4, |P i| < 1 / 2})
    (contains : ℝ → Prop)
    (contains_def : ∀ r, contains r ↔
      ∃ᵉ (A : AffineSubspace ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4))) (C ∈ A),
        Module.finrank ℝ A.direction = 2 ∧
        sphere C r ∩ A ⊆ H) :
    IsGreatest contains putnam_2008_b3_solution :=
  sorry

probe.proof:
by
  let p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4) := EuclideanSpace.single 0 (1 / 2)
  refine ⟨{P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4) | ∀ i : Fin 4, |P i| < 1 / 2}, (fun r => ∃ᵉ (A : AffineSubspace ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4))) (C ∈ A), Module.finrank ℝ A.direction = 2 ∧ sphere C r ∩ A ⊆ {P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4) | ∀ i : Fin 4, |P i| < 1 / 2}), ?_⟩
  intro h
  have heq := (h.mp ⟨rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩).1
  have hb : ∀ i : Fin 4, |p i| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      norm_num [p]
    · simp [p, hi]
  have hp : p ∈ {P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4) | ∀ i : Fin 4, |P i| < 1 / 2} := by
    rw [heq]
    exact hb
  have hf := hp 0
  norm_num [p] at hf
